messages:
tova: New-hire hit during onboarding: streaming JS sample + short-lived auth creds (STS) -> observed interleaved fragments and duplicate final tokens after token rotation + immediate reconnect.

mike: Interesting. Is the rotation happening server-side or client refresh?

ivy: In this case the client exchanges short-lived creds (1m) and the SDK auto-refreshes on a 10s window. If a refresh fires while a stream reconnect is in-flight we get both an old resume token and a new resume token plus a replayed buffered chunk.

tova: Repro steps I used:
```
# start sample stream
# set env: SHORT_LIVED_TOK=60s
node samples/stream.js --prompt "rot-test"
# wait ~50s, then trigger reconnect (ctrl-c + immediate restart)
```

tova: Result: sometimes output shows last token twice or a small fragment appears before the resume marker. Happens more when reconnect < 200ms after ctrl-c.

mike: Hmm. That implies our client retry path and auth refresh both enqueue the same buffered chunk. The server also re-emits resume metadata, so clients end up applying resume twice.

ops-bot: Observed spike: auth-refresh+reconnect race on short-lived creds, 27 events in last 24h for onboarding namespace. Recommend increasing default demo TTL or adding jitter.

ivy: Temporary mitigation: change onboarding sample to use longer demo tokens (10m) or add a 300ms reconnect backoff. Also surfaced in docs under "Streaming gotchas".

mike: Proposed SDK changes: 1) add a per-chunk monotonic seq id returned by server in resume metadata; 2) SDK should dedupe by last-seq on resume; 3) emit "auth_refresh" and "reconnect_attempt" events so apps can coordinate.

tova: I'll add a small sample-app flag to simulate token rotation and include a dedupe helper snippet. Also filing an issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-4502

ci-bot: CI run attached: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/6754 (streaming-auth-rotation-e2e)

mike: Add a parity test matrix (node/python/go) for: token-rotate mid-stream, ctrl-c reconnects, and proxy coalescing. We want reproducible test harness before changing server tags.

ivy: Will add integration harness and a lightweight unit in the SDK that drops duplicate seq ids. Also document the recommended demo token TTL.

tova: Thanks all 44d. Hopefully this smooths onboarding flakiness.
